message.content:
This vertical rectangular magazine cover features a large illustration of a person's face composed of six distinct rectangular panels arranged in two vertical columns and three horizontal rows. The panels display various artistic styles: the top-left is pink with painterly textures; the top-middle is blue and white watercolor; and the top-right features yellow and red Ben-Day dots. The lower panels use flat-color line art, smooth digital painting, and thick, textured brushstrokes.

At the top, black bold text reads "MENGAPA UJIAN NASIONAL BERANTAKAN". Below it is the word "TEMPO" in large, white, serif capital letters. Small text below says "EDISI 22-28 APRIL 20[unclear]". Across the center, white block letters read "GELAP-TERANG" above flowing blue cursive text reading "Hidup Kartini".

The central portrait depicts a person with dark hair pulled back in a bun, visible on the left side with a purple flower and white patterned hair ornament. The face occupies the center and right panels, with dark eyes and lips closed. In the bottom-left corner, a barcode and "RP 33.000" are visible visual. Along the left edge, vertical red text reads "TEMPO | GELAP-TERANG Hidup Kartini".
